sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-356)
sources.detail: Board-approved swap: +Terrasymbiosis / -Cultivate. Terrasymbiosis converts the deck's bulk counter placements into a repeatable, wrath-resilient draw engine; Cultivate cut as redundant ramp (Kodama's Reach retains the identical tapped-fetch + land-to-hand effect), ramp was the only over-target role.

sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-359)
sources.detail: Board-approved swap: +Mind into Matter / -Stroke of Genius. GU X-sorcery (draw X + cheat a permanent MV<=X into play tapped): triggers Zimone's first-X-spell engine and is copied by Unbound Flourishing's instant/sorcery clause (draw 2X + deploy two permanents). Replaces Stroke as the cuttable X-draw; Pull from Tomorrow retained for instant-speed flexibility. Board chose to cut Stroke (single-U pip) over Pull after a wash-level economy comparison (both net M-3 cards per mana).

sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-359)
sources.detail: Board-approved swap: +Overflowing Basin / -Tangled Islet. GU dual that enters untapped (vs Islet's enters-tapped) and taps for {1},{T}: GU — net +1 mana, fitting the ramp-big-mana archetype, while trimming one tapland per B4 manabase philosophy. Still a normal land drop for Zimone's prime-count trigger. Tradeoff: Basin makes 0 mana on its own (needs another untapped source to pay {1}); deck already runs Simic Growth Chamber as its other conditional land. Colors and spell composition unchanged.

sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-359)
sources.detail: Board-approved swap: +Owlin Spiralmancer / -Pathbreaker Ibex. Owlin ({3}{U} 3/4 flyer) copies the first X-spell each turn of ANY type, extending the copy engine to the deck's X-creature Hydras that Unbound Flourishing's instant/sorcery-only copy clause can't reach; copied 'enters with X counters' Hydras are full X/X bodies whose counters get doubled, and on X instants/sorceries Owlin stacks with Unbound Flourishing for a double-copy. Board chose to cut Pathbreaker Ibex (6 CMC, +X/+X until-EOT = no counter synergy, redundant overrun finisher) over Master Biomancer. Caveat: copies aren't cast (CR 707.10), so cast-triggered Hydras (Hydroid Krasis, Genesis Hydra) yield only a body on the copy.

sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-359)
sources.detail: Board-approved swap: +Turbulent Wilderness / -1 Forest (13->12). Fetchable G/U dual (Forest Island types — grabbable by Nature's Lore/Three Visits); its 'enters tapped unless opponents control 8+ lands' clause counts all opponents combined, so in a 4-player pod it enters untapped from ~turn 3. Manabase polish over a basic; colors and spell composition unchanged.

sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-359)
sources.detail: Assessed and declined: Mockingbird (clone copies printed stats not counters — ignores the deck's doubler/Ascendancy engine; keep Managorger Hydra as a doubler-multiplied counter snowball).

sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-356)
sources.detail: Board-approved swap: +Fierce Guardianship / -An Offer You Can't Refuse. Free hard counter (noncreature) while Zimone is on the battlefield — the deck's normal state — and removes An Offer's two-Treasure donation to the caster. Adds the deck's 2nd Game Changer (gameChangers 1->2), legal at Bracket 4. Both counter noncreature spells only, so counter count and role coverage are unchanged.

sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-359)
sources.detail: Board-approved swap: +Lattice Library / -Master Biomancer. Lattice ({X}{G}{G} enchantment) enters with X study counters and creates a Fractal token sized to those counters on ETB and on each turn's first X-spell — a board-wipe-proof recurring token engine (resilience patch: metric 54->57). X doubled by Unbound Flourishing; Fractal + counters doubled by Doubling Season. Replaces Master Biomancer (non-X build-around). Worktree-isolated metrics: global flat 72, interaction held 111, resilience +3, sim A/81.4.

sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-359)
sources.detail: Board-approved swap: +Nev, the Practical Dean / -Warden of the Grove. Nev ({2}{G}) grants team-wide trample to creatures with +1/+1 counters (nearly the whole board) — redundant evasion for the oversized-combat finish, previously gated on Zegana alone — and grows by X on each turn's first X-spell. Cut Warden as the only non-X engine creature (fixed {2}{G}, lowest synergy with the X-spell payoff suite); board picked Warden over Benevolent Hydra (kept for its '+1 counters to other creatures' amplifier + X-spell trigger). Metrics identical, sim a 0.2 wash.

sources.name: Card assessment (DEC-555)
sources.detail: Board-approved swaps: +Syncopate / -Guardian Project and +Mathemagics / -Tatyova, Benthic Druid. Syncopate ({X}{U} instant, exile clause) fills the gaps[]-listed counterspell slot (4 to 5 of 6) and is the fourth instant X-spell able to claim an opponent-turn 'first X spell' Zimone trigger slot; with N counters on Zimone, {U} counters unless they pay N. Mathemagics ({X}{X}{U}{U}) draws 2^X and scales with Zimone's discount (6 counters: X=4 for 4 mana, 16 cards); Unbound Flourishing copies it. Cuts are both card-draw (surplus 8.0 to 7.0 role points, still above target): Guardian Project was the weakest of three draw engines (27 nontoken creatures), Tatyova about one card per turn on a fragile 5-mana 3/3. Zero-write projection: global health 72 to 73, counterspell gap closed, no new gap. EDHREC: Syncopate 50.4%, Mathemagics 56.2%.

sources.name: EDHREC — Zimone, Infinite Analyst (DEC-555 check)
sources.detail: Syncopate 50.4% and Mathemagics 56.2% inclusion on the commander page, both above the 40% closing-diff bar.

sources.name: Re-assessment swap round (DEC-556)
sources.detail: Trigger-2 re-assessment, board-approved round of 6 owned swaps targeting the removal-spot (25) and wincon (67) gaps: +Kinetic Ooze / -Hangarback Walker (X-body with counter-doubling upside plus artifact/enchantment removal on ETB; EDHREC 84.5%); +Primal Might / -Paradise Druid (X-spell fight removal that triggers Zimone); +Reality Shift / -Tanazir Quandrix (2-mana exile removal; board redirected the cut from The Goose Mother to Tanazir to keep the Food engine); +Overwhelming Stampede / -Primo, the Unbounded (dedicated overrun wincon); +Reliquary Tower / -Temple of Mystery (no maximum hand size for the X-draw suite; EDHREC 88.8%; cuts a tapland); +Alchemist's Refuge / -Rain-Slicked Copse (flash for end-of-turn Hydras and opponent-turn Zimone triggers; cuts a tapland). Board declined Oversimplify (removal-board gap accepted as open) and the Green Sun's Zenith purchase (Mossborn Hydra stays).

guideContent.strategyOverview: Exponential Growth is the +1/+1 counters / Hydra go-big build of Zimone, Infinite Analyst — a Bracket-4 Simic deck whose plan is to cast X-cost Hydras and X-creatures (the first X-spell each turn grows Zimone by two counters and is discounted by {1} per counter on her), multiply those counters with stacked doublers (Doubling Season, Unbound Flourishing, Branching Evolution, Innkeeper's Talent, Kalonian Hydra), and close through oversized trample combat, an unblockable counters alpha-strike (Herald of Secret Streams), an overrun (Finale of Devastation at X≥10), or the Simic Ascendancy alternate win. It is deliberately distinct from the existing Calculated Infinity (X-spell storm/combo) Zimone deck: this is a resilient creature-combat midrange deck, not a combo deck (0 unintended infinite combos). Built under an owned-collection constraint — 11 strategy-specific cards to acquire, everything else owned or a generic staple.

synergies.title: Zimone + X-Hydras: discounted, snowballing threats
synergies.description: Each turn's first X-spell puts two +1/+1 counters on Zimone and is discounted by {1} per counter on her, so every Hydra you cast makes the next one cheaper. Unbound Flourishing doubles X on those Hydra (permanent) casts, so a Primordial Hydra or Hydroid Krasis enters twice as large.

synergies.title: Doubling Season + Kalonian Hydra: counters spiral
synergies.description: Doubling Season doubles every counter that enters (Hydras come in twice as big). Kalonian Hydra then doubles all +1/+1 counters on each creature you control whenever it attacks — one combat step can quadruple your board.

synergies.title: Unblockable / trample finish
synergies.description: Herald of Secret Streams makes every creature with a +1/+1 counter unblockable; Zegana grants them all trample. Either turns a tall counter board into a lethal swing.

synergies.title: Owlin Spiralmancer: copy the first X-spell
synergies.description: Owlin copies your first X-spell each turn — including the Hydras, which Unbound Flourishing's instant/sorcery-only copy clause can't touch. The token copy of an 'enters with X counters' Hydra is a full X/X whose counters are then doubled by Doubling Season / Branching Evolution. On X instants/sorceries (Finale of Devastation, Pull from Tomorrow) Owlin stacks with Unbound Flourishing for a double-copy. Caveat: a copy isn't cast (CR 707.10), so cast-triggered Hydras like Hydroid Krasis and Genesis Hydra yield only a body on the copy, not their draw/dig.

synergies.title: Terrasymbiosis: bulk counters into cards
synergies.description: Terrasymbiosis draws cards equal to the +1/+1 counters placed in a single event (once per turn). A Hydra entering with X counters — doubled by Doubling Season/Branching Evolution — or a Forgotten Ancient counter dump turns one trigger into a 5-15 card refill. As an enchantment it survives board wipes, refueling the engine when the creatures don't.

synergies.title: Simic Ascendancy alternate win
synergies.description: Every +1/+1 counter you place adds a growth counter to Simic Ascendancy; at 20 you win at upkeep. With doublers placing counters in bulk, this can close even through a stalled board.

synergies.title: Nev, the Practical Dean: team trample
synergies.description: Nev gives trample to every creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter — nearly the whole board here — so oversized Hydras punch through chump blockers without leaning on Zegana alone. It also grows by X whenever you cast your first X-spell each turn, feeding the counter doublers.

synergies.title: Lattice Library: wipe-proof Fractal engine
synergies.description: Lattice Library enters with X study counters and creates a Fractal token (sized to those counters) on ETB and on each turn's first X-spell. As an enchantment it survives board wipes, rebuilding a threat every turn; Unbound Flourishing doubles its X and Doubling Season doubles both the token and its +1/+1 counters.

winConditions.title: Oversized trample combat
winConditions.description: Doublers (Doubling Season, Kalonian Hydra) balloon the Hydras; Zegana grants the team trample for a lethal swing.

winConditions.title: Unblockable counters alpha-strike
winConditions.description: Herald of Secret Streams makes every creature with a +1/+1 counter unblockable — a tall counter board connects unimpeded.

winConditions.title: Finale of Devastation overrun
winConditions.description: Cast for X>=10 to tutor a creature onto the battlefield and give your whole board +X/+X and haste.

winConditions.title: Overwhelming Stampede overrun
winConditions.description: Creatures you control gain trample and get +X/+X, where X is your greatest power — one oversized Hydra turns the whole board lethal.

winConditions.title: Simic Ascendancy alternate win
winConditions.description: Every +1/+1 counter placed adds growth counters; at 20 you win at upkeep — doublers get there fast.
